svg.title: brains: one trigger short
svg.desc: trigalign on a public EEG session (OpenNeuro ds004621, CC0): 194 of 195 stimulus-log events paired with an EEG trigger; clock offset 347.7 s, drift -22 ppm, pairing residuals sd 0.29 ms, max 0.54 ms, drawn on an axis of ±0.6 ms. The last event, at 290.778 s on the log clock, has no trigger: one was expected at 638.47 s, where the recording paused. Hollow circle on the recorder axis, labelled 1 extra trigger: a trigger with no log event.
svg.text: a public EEG session, one trigger lost
not a brainwave: each pair's miss, ±0.6 ms
